strings.zh: 小赤『真的是太好吃啊……{NEWLINE}我……
strings.en: Red: It’s so good... I...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『怎么了小赤？{NEWLINE}听你的声音怎么有点梗咽呢？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What’s wrong, Red? Your{NEWLINE}voice sounds kind of choked up.

strings.zh: 小赤『唉……我想起以前{NEWLINE}在火箭队的时候,{CLEAR}经常吃不饱,还要被一树梨花他们欺负,{CLEAR}现在火箭队终于被打倒了,{CLEAR}我也不用过那样的生活了。{SCROLL}小赤『真的谢谢你啊{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}如果不是你打败了坂木,{CLEAR}真不知道这个世界会变成什么样子。
strings.en: Red: *sigh*... It reminded me of{NEWLINE}when I was in Team Rocket. I was{CLEAR}always hungry, and Will and Karen{CLEAR}and the others picked on me.{SCROLL}Now Team Rocket’s finally{NEWLINE}been beaten, and I don’t have{CLEAR}to live like that anymore.{SCROLL}Red: Thank you so much, {VAR:0103:0}.{NEWLINE}If you hadn’t beaten Giovanni, I don’t{CLEAR}know what this world would have become.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『放心吧小赤,一切都过去了,{NEWLINE}白色的明天在等着我们。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t worry, Red.{NEWLINE}It’s all over now. A bright{CLEAR}white future awaits us.

strings.zh: 小赤『哈哈,你在学火箭队说话。
strings.en: Red: Ha ha, now you{NEWLINE}sound like Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 小赤『听到了吗,{VAR:0103:0}。{NEWLINE}度假区在办情侣双打比赛,{CLEAR}咱们也去报名参赛吧！
strings.en: Red: Did you hear that, {VAR:0103:0}?{NEWLINE}The Resort Zone is holding a Couples{CLEAR}Double Battle. Let’s go sign up!

strings.zh: 小赤『咱们走！
strings.en: Red: Let’s go!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『该咱们登场了小赤。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: We’re up, Red.

strings.zh: 小赤『好,我不会拖你后腿的。
strings.en: Red: OK. I won’t slow you down.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小赤,感谢你能{NEWLINE}出现在我的生命中,{CLEAR}过去跟你在一起的时光非常幸福。{CLEAR}在未来,我将用我的全部热情和爱意,{CLEAR}来陪伴你、支持你、照顾你。{CLEAR}我将与你一起度过{CLEAR}今后人生的每一个阶段,{CLEAR}经历生活的每一种色彩、{CLEAR}分享生活的每一份喜悦,{CLEAR}分担生活的每一次痛苦。{CLEAR}直到永远……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Red, thank you for coming{NEWLINE}into my life. Every moment with{CLEAR}you so far has made me so happy.{SCROLL}From now on, with all my heart and{NEWLINE}all my love, I’ll be by your side,{CLEAR}support you and take care of you.{SCROLL}I’ll share every stage{NEWLINE}of life with you...{SCROLL}every color of it, every{NEWLINE}joy, and every pain.{SCROLL}Forever and always...

strings.zh: 小赤『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}你就像大海上的灯塔一样,{CLEAR}让我在迷茫中找到了前进的方向。{CLEAR}从今往后无论是富贵还是穷困、{CLEAR}健康还是疾病、顺境还是逆境,{CLEAR}我都将永远陪在你的身边,{CLEAR}直到永远……
strings.en: Red: {VAR:0103:0}, you’re like{NEWLINE}a lighthouse on the sea. When I was{CLEAR}lost, you showed me the way forward.{SCROLL}From now on, for richer or{NEWLINE}poorer, in sickness and in health,{CLEAR}in good times and in bad...{SCROLL}I’ll always be by your{NEWLINE}side. Forever and always...

strings.zh: 小赤『但是今后咱们两个{NEWLINE}再也不会走散……
strings.en: Red: But from now on, the two of us{NEWLINE}will never go our separate ways...

strings.zh: 小赤『那是当然的！{SCROLL}小赤『咱们出来旅行也有段时间了,{NEWLINE}差不多也该回吉野市了,走吧。
strings.en: Red: Of course!{SCROLL}Red: We’ve been traveling a while{NEWLINE}now. It’s about time we headed back{CLEAR}to Cherrygrove City. Let’s go.
